title: SRA: Selective Residual Adaptation for LLM Reasoning Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2610.34199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight students. However, distilled small models still struggle with multi-step reasoning. We observe that the distribution divergences between teacher and student models along reasoning paths are highly sparse, and target tokens almost always fall within the student top-$K$ candidate set. Based on this finding, unlike approaches updating student backbones or requiring runtime teacher computation, we propose Selective Residual Adaptation (SRA), a plug-and-play framework that internalizes localized corrections. Concretely, SRA employs a Discrepancy Gate to identify divergence positions alongside a Candidate Residual Adapter for top-$K$ logit calibration to correct the mismatch. Theoretically, we establish error bounds ensuring strict sequence level performance gains. Across mathematical benchmarks on Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 4B, SRA consistently

translated_title: SRA：用于增强大语言模型推理能力的选择性残差适配
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏能够将大语言模型的推理能力迁移到轻量级的学生模型中。然而，经过蒸馏的小模型在多步推理任务上仍然表现不佳。我们观察到，教师模型与学生模型在推理路径上的分布差异高度稀疏，且目标token几乎总是落在学生模型的top-K候选集合之内。基于这一发现，与更新学生模型主干网络或需要在运行时进行教师模型计算的方法不同，我们提出了选择性残差适配，这是一种能够将局部化修正内化到模型中的即插即用框架。具体而言，SRA采用差异门控来识别分布差异的位置，并结合候选残差适配器对top-K logits进行校准，以纠正不匹配问题。在理论层面，我们建立了误差界，确保了严格的序列级性能提升。在0.6B到4B参数规模的Qwen3模型的数学基准测试中，SRA始终……
tldr: 提出了一种即插即用的选择性残差适配框架SRA，通过差异门控识别师生模型的分布差异位置，并利用候选残差适配器校准top-K logits，从而在不更新学生模型主干、不依赖运行时教师模型计算的前提下，显著增强小模型的多步推理能力。
